visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth/Building): A larva carefully 'gluing' a tiny geode fragment to its silk tube with its front legs; Top-Right (Dining): The adult caddisfly sipping nectar from a primitive Cretaceous flower; Bottom-Left (Sleeping): The adult resting on tree bark, perfectly camouflaged against the lichen; Bottom-Right (Playing/Social): A swarm of adult caddisflies dancing in a 'cloud' over the water during twilight.
visual_logic.style_notes: The 'Building' quadrant should look like a craft project, emphasizing the 'engineer' aspect of the insect.
